title: AsrixBD Modpack
description: AsrixBD Modpack is a lightweight Fabric modpack that boosts FPS, graphics, and gameplay while keeping the vanilla Minecraft experience.
body:
**AsrixBD Modpack**  

**Overview:**  
AsrixBD Modpack is a lightweight Fabric modpack designed to enhance **performance, graphics, and gameplay quality** while maintaining the **classic vanilla Minecraft experience**. It offers optimized performance, shader support, and essential quality-of-life improvements for a smooth and enjoyable Minecraft experience.  

**Performance:**  
Optimized with **Sodium, Lithium, and EntityCulling**, the modpack delivers **higher FPS, reduced lag**, and smoother gameplay across all hardware, including lower-end devices.  

**Graphics:**  
Supports **Iris shaders** for enhanced lighting, improved visuals, and a more immersive world without sacrificing performance.  

**Quality-of-Life Features:**  
- **Xaero’s Minimap & World Map** – advanced navigation tools  
- **AppleSkin** – better hunger management  
- **Mouse Tweaks** – streamlined inventory handling  
- **Mod Menu** – centralized mod configuration  

**Multiplayer Compatibility:**  
All included mods are **non-intrusive**, ensuring full compatibility with most servers and multiplayer worlds.  

**Fabric-Based:**  
Built on the **lightweight Fabric mod loader**, providing fast load times, modularity, and easy expandability for additional mods.  

**Open & Up-to-Date:**  
AsrixBD Modpack receives regular updates for new Minecraft versions while retaining settings where possible. Most included mods are **open-source**, supporting collaborative development and customization.  

**Included Mods:**  
- AppleSkin  
- Architectury API  
- BewisClient  
- Cloth Config  
- CustomSkinLoader  
- EntityCulling  
- Fabric API  
- Fabric Language Kotlin  
- Iris Shaders  
- Lithium  
- Mod Menu  
- Mouse Tweaks  
- Sodium  
- ViaFabricPlus  
- Xaero’s Minimap  
- Xaero’s World Map  
- Yet Another Config Lib
- Replay Mod
- Simple Voice Chat
- Wavey Capes
